fusions.name: Stampede Front
fusions.desc: A stampede of stingers in a wide cone that deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores armour, with a 50% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gallop Prick
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Full Tilt
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Momentum Built
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
